Overview

MASST performs repository-scale searching of a query tandem mass spectrum against public GNPS/MassIVE data and spectral libraries. It is designed to place a spectrum in biological or environmental context by identifying datasets and files in which related fragmentation spectra occur.

Detailed capability map

What can this tool do?

Repository-scale spectral searchSpectral-library matching

Common uses

  • Search a query MS/MS spectrum across public GNPS datasets.
  • Identify datasets, files, and public-library spectra related to a query spectrum.

Scope and considerations

Designed for

  • Repository-scale contextualization of individual MS/MS spectra.

Important requirements

  • A centroided query MS/MS spectrum with precursor information.

Considerations

  • Search tolerances and similarity thresholds affect which public matches are returned.
